concerns.text: T023 (compute_intervals.py) is marked [US2] but depends on T018/T019 (US1 edge cases) which are unchecked. The 'Independent Test' for US2 assumes `learners_raw.csv` exists with valid data, but T020 (generation of that file) is also unchecked. US2 cannot execute before US1 filtering/generation is complete.

T029 (models.py) and T032 (sensitivity.py) are marked [US3] but depend on T026 (learners_binned.csv) which is unchecked. The 'Independent Test' for US3 assumes binned data exists. US3 cannot execute before US2 binning is complete.

T009 (schema validation) is unchecked. T016 (download) and T017 (preprocess) in Phase 3 implicitly rely on schema validation to ensure data integrity before processing. While T009 is marked [P], it is a foundational prerequisite for the data pipeline tasks in Phase 3.

The 'Checkpoint' text in Phase 3 claims 'User Story 1 should be fully functional' despite T018, T019, and T020 being unchecked. This creates a false dependency state where downstream tasks (US2) appear ready to run on incomplete data.
